name: 07950 · Morris Plains, NJ
findings: ZIP 07950 (Morris Plains) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07950 (Morris Plains) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07950 (Morris Plains) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
